description: Different hosts should preserve JavaScript execution hints for existing-test extension, service implementation, and deferred DTO review.

lockedFields.reason: Every JavaScript plan item should receive a deterministic hint.
This compact fixture has no infrastructure-sensitive plan item.
The hint remains attached to the stable parser extension item.
Existing-test extension is conservatively medium complexity.
The parser source and existing Vitest file are both required context.
Existing test edits are serialized to avoid shared-file collisions.
The auth service remains ordinary implementation work without naming a model.
The unit-level service item has no framework or build boundary signal.
The DTO defer item should not be routed to implementation.
Hosts should always retain repository instructions even for review-only items.
